Trading volume on the CSE All Share index rose to 89.3 million shares from 53.9 million in the previous session
The equity market's turnover rose to 2.65 billion Sri Lankan rupees ($7.97 million) from 1.45 billion rupees in the previous session, according to exchange data
Foreign investors were net buyers, purchasing stocks worth 105.1 million rupees, while domestic investors were net sellers, offloading shares worth 2.58 billion rupees, the data showed
